layer_1_database_record_identity.rationale: Primary source supports subtilomycin identity, B. subtilis MMA7 source, broad antimicrobial phenotype, and modified mature sequence context. DRAMP's plain sequence is preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized; dbAMP lacks local sequence/literature packet fields and remains database_only_no_primary_source.

layer_2_activity_toxicity_evidence.rationale: Worker-2 source review extracted every local Table 1 qualitative activity/no-activity value, including culture and peptide columns plus footnote negatives. The source does not report MIC, zone diameter, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or cell viability values, so none were invented.

layer_3_mechanism_ontology.rationale: The paper supports antimicrobial phenotype, lantibiotic biosynthetic/structural context, and physicochemical stability. It does not directly test molecular target, membrane pore formation, lipid-II binding, ROS, or translation effects; these remain non-promoted cautions.

supplementary_materials.rationale: The supplementary PDF contains strain, primer, protein homology, and mass-spectrum support, but no additional activity/toxicity table that changes the final activity layer.

final_adjudication.rationale: The prior blocking findings are resolved or preserved as nonblocking cautions with source paths and locators. No blocking/major issue or open rework target remains.

caution_findings.note: Activity values are qualitative halo scores, not MICs or measured zone diameters; normalization is not possible.
DRAMP stores a plain 32-residue sequence while the primary source reports modified lantibiotic notation and thioether/methylthioether context.
Packet has one dbAMP experiment/basic row but no dbAMP sequence or literature row; not promoted to source_verified.
No primary hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or cell-viability endpoint values were found in local XML/PDF/supplement text.
Generic lantibiotic background was not promoted into direct subtilomycin mechanism claims.
